data.body:
Hello Mesa Electrical Field Services,

Please carry out work order WO-1 on INV-3 (reseat_comms_card).

Steps, in order:
  1. Notify operations and maintenance personnel per §1910.147(c)(6)(i)
  2. Shut down the inverter and isolate power sources per plant shutdown procedure
  3. Verify power is isolated at the inverter's dedicated AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker (52-In) before accessing INV-3 cabinet
  4. Confirm zero energy by performing a voltage test on the isolated circuit
  5. Apply lockout/tagout devices to the AC disconnect switch and upstream breaker per plant LOTO program §1910.147(c)(7)
  6. Verify mains and PV input isolation are OFF before accessing the inverter compartment.
  7. Open INV-3 cabinet door and locate the inverter comms card (usually mounted on the side or rear panel).
  8. Carefully unseat the comms card by pulling it straight out of its socket, inspecting the card edge and connector for corrosion or bent pins.
  9. Reinsert the comms card firmly until it seats fully (listen/feel for the latch click).
  10. Close the cabinet door, restore mains and PV input, and power cycle the inverter.
  11. Monitor SCADA for data freshness (target < 5 min) and verify the inverter display is lit and responding.
  12. If communication remains down, proceed to replace the comms card.
  13. Inspect the LOTO devices for damage and ensure all personnel are clear of the equipment
  14. Remove all lockout/tagout devices in accordance with §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(A)(1) and §1910.147(c)(7)(iii)(B)
  15. Restore power by closing breaker 52-In (AC disconnect switch)
  16. Notify personnel that the system has been re-energized and perform a start-up check before resuming operations

Do not:
  - Do not attempt to reseat the comms card with power applied; risk of electrical shock or further hardware damage.
  - Do not force the card if resistance is felt; check for obstructions or misalignment before reinserting.

We will verify against the plant before closing this order:
  - INV-3 SCADA data_age_min at most 5 and status running
  - INV-3 answers comms_ping (its comms card is back on the network)
  - INV-3 display lit and showing readings in a camera view the verifier picks, not the contractor's photo
  - JEV verdict 'verified' from the registered camera stations and the sensor state

Reply to this email when the work is done.

GridTwin Ops (automated agent team)
